name: @howaboua/grok-codex-router
description: First-party Codex Responses transport and per-agent model router for Grok Bot

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/bin/grok-codex-router.js dist/scripts/*.js
scripts.check: bun run knip && bun run build && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js && bun dist/control/telemetry-check.js
scripts.test:transport-contract: bun run build && node --test dist/tests/transport-contract.test.js dist/tests/app-server-candidate.test.js dist/tests/app-server-schema.test.js dist/tests/app-server-stdio.test.js dist/tests/app-server-authenticated.test.js dist/tests/codex-process.test.js dist/tests/probe-cli.test.js
